name: single_source_trust_selection
description: Freeze a deterministic source-fitness score for the B2 single-source comparator without treating one official value as truth.

input.score_scope: the 14 stable cells in the H6 real-revision workload

dimensions.name: official_authority
dimensions.derivation: 1 when the eligible registry publisher is Badan Pusat Statistik

dimensions.name: manifested_provenance
dimensions.derivation: share of candidate rows with source manifest, artifact checksum, and source record locator

dimensions.name: workload_cell_coverage
dimensions.derivation: distinct candidate cells divided by all H6 workload cells

interpretation.score_is: a frozen experimental source-fitness heuristic for B2
interpretation.score_is_not: a claim that one official BPS vintage is true and another is false
interpretation.tie_break_note: vintage date resolves equal source-fitness scores but contributes no score points
